title: Good Evening
label: ch:hi-good-evening
canDo: I can wish someone good evening in Hindi and choose between शुभ संध्या and नमस्ते by register.

payoff.summary: Unpack संध्या as 'holding together' and साँझ as its doublet, pick out श and झ, then pick शुभ संध्या for a written evening card and नमस्ते for a casual 7 p.m. hello, treating the split as a tendency, not a ban.
payoff.note: HI-C32-evening-register is the chapter's last lesson (sequence 840) and assesses all 5 atoms it introduces: संध्या's meaning and its doublet साँझ, the letters झ and श, and the evening register choice.
